en.headline: Police officer denies mishandling DNA samples in Abby Choi trial
en.dek: Sergeant Lam Chun rejected claims in the High Court that samples from the victim’s ex-husband were not properly labelled or sealed before laboratory testing.
body: A police officer denied in the High Court on Thursday that he failed to properly label DNA samples taken from Abby Choi’s ex-husband Alex Kwong after his arrest in 2023.

Sergeant Lam Chun, who was a detective constable at the time, also denied using excessive force when officers subdued Kwong as he prepared to leave Hong Kong via the Tung Chung Development Ferry Pier on 25 February 2023. He said Kwong sustained a small abrasion on his right cheek during a struggle.
The trial continues with three men facing murder charges over the death of the 28-year-old socialite. Forensic evidence and chain-of-custody issues have been central to the proceedings.

zh.headline: 蔡天鳳案審訊 警官否認不當處理DNA樣本
zh.dek: 林警司在高等法院否認未妥善標示及密封被告鄧港智的口腔拭子樣本，亦否認逮捕時使用過度武力。
body: 高等法院今日繼續審理蔡天鳳被殺案，一名警官否認在2023年逮捕鄧港智後，未有妥善標示及以防篡改袋密封其DNA樣本。
當時仍任偵探警署警長的林振表示，鄧港智於2023年2月25日在東涌發展碼頭準備離港時與警員發生拉扯，面部受輕微擦傷，但否認使用過度武力。
案件三名被告被控謀殺罪，審訊持續進行，證據處理及保管鏈問題一直是控辯雙方爭議焦點。
